# clavis access

<p class="cli-lead">Explain, request, approve and review access</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis access <command>
```

</div>

Find out why someone has access, and grant temporary access instead of
permanent roles: request it for an hour, get it approved, and it expires
on its own.
